_comment: Example config for the restock_waitlist module. Copy to clients/<client_name>/restock_waitlist.json and edit the values for your business.
_templates_note: Override per language. Available placeholders: {sku} {name} {business_name} {contact_phone}. Builtin fallbacks exist for en/zh/af/am.

templates.en:
🎉 {sku} ({name}) is back in stock at {business_name}!
Contact {contact_phone} to order.
(Reply STOP to opt out.)

_af_hint_words_note: Tokens used to detect Afrikaans (which shares Latin script with English). Defaults to 14 common AF words if omitted.
